name: Haus Alpenblick
beschreibung:
Situated in the historic mountaineering village of Vent above 1,900 metres, Haus Alpenblick welcomes hikers and climbers with cosy rooms and genuine mountain warmth.

The Wildspitze, the Vent chairlift, and high-alpine climbing trails are right on the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Alpenblick in Vent offers high-altitude serenity at the base of the Oetztal glacier summits.
